retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast 1980s pop aesthetic featuring a central subject in patterned fashion, framed by a thick black border and topped with large, textured display typography.
triggerTerms: high contrast black and white photography with pink accents

recipe.visualDefinition: A studio portrait of a dynamic figure in a leopard print jacket against a stark white background, enclosed in a rough black frame. The composition is dominated by oversized, pink-textured block lettering at the top and a small, widely-spaced subtitle on the right.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject interaction with background through high-contrast silhouettes
Textural contrast between the leopard print and the stippled pink typography
Spatial tension between the large header and the tiny, airy subtitle
Framing device that contains the energy of the central pose
coreInvariants: Pink stippled/halftone texture inside large glyphs
High-contrast black and white subject photography

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central figure, three-quarter length, leaning left with dynamic arm movement, occupying 60% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, pink display text at the top edge acts as the primary visual weight.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bold pink header, follows the subject's gaze down to the left, then moves across the torso to the small subtitle on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive white space around the subject to emphasize the silhouette and leopard pattern.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between black and white, with a medium-saturation pink providing the only hue.
paletteRestrictions: Strictly limited to Black, White, and Pink

letterConstructionRules: Interior fill replaced with a dense, irregular stippled or 'brain-coral' texture
characterSpecificRedesigns: The texture must be consistent across all large glyphs, ignoring standard lighting or shading.

composition.relationshipToImage: layered behind the topmost elements of the subject

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme contrast between heavy, textured display sans and delicate, widely-spaced italic serif.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary blocky skeleton for the display text.
Provides the elegant, high-contrast serif look for the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A high-contrast black and white studio photograph of a person in a leopard print blazer, posed dynamically against a pure white background, enclosed in a thick, slightly distressed black border frame.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large uppercase condensed sans-serif text at the top in bubblegum pink with a stippled texture. Add a small, lowercase italic serif subtitle in the lower right with extremely wide letter spacing.

verificationChecks: Is the pink text textured with a stippled pattern?
Is the border a thick black frame?
Is the subject in high-contrast black and white?
Is the subtitle text tiny and widely spaced?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original artist
Exact wording of the album title

mustAchieve: Distinct stippled texture in the header

postGenerationChecks: Check that the pink text is layered slightly behind the subject's hair.
Verify the leopard print is high-contrast black on white/grey.
Ensure the black border is present and encloses the entire composition.
Confirm the subtitle is lowercase and italicized.
recipe.reuseFormula: High-contrast B&W subject + Leopard print + Pink stippled display type + Thick black frame = 80s Pop Aesthetic.
